description: Provides timezone-aware date operations to other features by reading the device's local calendar date, checking for existing entries on a given date, and recording local dates for achievement entries

props.text: Provides timezone-aware date operations to other features by reading the device's local calendar date, checking for existing entries on a given date, and recording local dates for achievement entries
Exposes the device's current local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for use by other features
Checks whether an achievement entry already exists for a given local date to support one-per-day enforcement and midnight rollover detection
Associates an achievement entry with the device's local calendar date to ensure entries are stored under the correct local day
JavaScript client-side logic that reads the device's local date using new Date() and formats it as YYYY-MM-DD before sending to backend
